    • occupy

      public void occupy(Player p)
      Assigns the tile to a player (totem placement) and RESTORES the available picks to their full value. Not to be used during crash recovery: in that case restoreOccupant(Player) is needed to avoid resetting the already spent picks.
      Parameters:
      p - the player who occupies the tile

    • freeSlot

      public void freeSlot()

    • restoreOccupant

      public void restoreOccupant(Player p)
      Re-links the occupant reference WITHOUT touching the remaining pick counters. Used during JSON recovery: occupy() would reset the picks to full and wipe the progress the player had already made before the crash.
